summary: Append-only transactional observations, migration 7, authorized manual capture, drained daily scheduling, and history UI with comparability breaks and numeric table.
limitations: No PostgreSQL/full suite/browser/build/deployment was run by worker; lead owns those lanes.
History starts with real captures; no reconstructed prior observations.
UI shows latest 60 workspace observations; older observations are retained and bounded API reads support up to 200.
Capture work is serialized per workspace; scheduler checks every 15 minutes, initial 30 seconds, and never overlaps itself.
Catalog identity memoizes immutable loaded FrameworkIndex graphs; changing corpus requires the existing registry/restart workflow.
